page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-176-lssd is a high-capacity server powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8481C processor. It features 176 dedicated vCPUs across 88 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 704 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4 GB of memory per vCPU. Storage is a key highlight, featuring 12,599 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 32 local SSDs, while no GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, this instance demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests and Passmark CPU scores. Its memory subsystem delivers exceptional throughput, with uncached large-block read bandwidth reaching 445.45 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 194.75 GB/sec, both ranking in the top tier. The server also excels in high-throughput operations, achieving top-tier results in Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput, alongside strong performance in multi-threaded decompression and software compilation.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c3-standard-176-lssd offers high resource density by bundling massive local NVMe storage directly with dedicated, high-count compute resources. This integration reduces the need for external storage attachments, though the lack of GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff for specialized AI training. This server is highly suited for large-scale database deployments, high-throughput web serving, intensive multi-threaded data processing, and enterprise-grade workloads requiring rapid local storage access.
